WITH per_observatory AS (
  SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM telescopes
  GROUP BY observstation
), shares AS (
  SELECT observstation,
         telescope_count,
         1.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM per_observatory
)
SELECT observstation,
       telescope_count,
       share,
       share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference_from_average_share
FROM shares
ORDER BY difference_from_average_share DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Observatories are the distinct non-NULL observstation values represented in telescopes; observatories with no telescopes are excluded because the request asks for each observatory value in the telescopes table.
